en.headline: 2 own commits plus 20 automated commits; 2 issues touched

In `anomalyco/opencode`, the user commented on issue #55772, “[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it”, which has 2 comments. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or state changes were recorded.
